description: ACCOUNT-LEVEL numbers for a Bluesky account — FOLLOWERS, following and total posts — plus display name, bio, avatar and when it was created. With no argument it reads the CONNECTED account, which is the answer to “how many followers do we have on Bluesky”; pass `actor` (a handle or DID) to read any other account, which is free and is how you size a competitor there. The reply says which one it read: `self` is true only for the connected account, compared on the DID because a Bluesky handle can change. A counter Bluesky does not return comes back under `absent` with the reason and is NEVER reported as zero — all three are optional in the lexicon. Read-only, 0 credits, no extra permission. Needs Bluesky connected (Connectors > Bluesky, or connect_connector).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

actor.description: a Bluesky handle (hermoso.ai or @hermoso.ai) or a did:plc:… — omit it to read the connected account

name: bluesky_account
title: Read a Bluesky account
